description: This file defines the Drupal file entity class, including its properties, methods, and behaviors related to file management within Drupal.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file entity in Drupal, providing methods for file properties, lifecycle hooks, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the file.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the file.

methods.name: getFileUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the file.

methods.name: setFileUri
methods.description: Sets the URI of the file.

methods.name: createFileUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for the file, relative or absolute.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: setMimeType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the file.

methods.name: isPermanent
methods.description: Checks if the file is marked as permanent.

methods.name: isTemporary
methods.description: Checks if the file is marked as temporary.

methods.name: setPermanent
methods.description: Marks the file as permanent.

methods.name: setTemporary
methods.description: Marks the file as temporary.

methods.name: preCreate
methods.description: Prepares default values before creating a new file entity.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Performs actions before saving the file entity, such as setting size.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup before deleting the file entity, including usage cleanup and file deletion.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the base fields for the file entity.

methods.name: getDefaultEntityOwner
methods.description: Returns the default owner of the entity, null in this case.

methods.name: invalidateTagsOnSave
methods.description: Invalidates cache tags related to the file entity upon save.

methods.name: getDownloadHeaders
methods.description: Returns HTTP headers for file download.
